references.text: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth – a repetition of the information about Noah's sons in connection with the account of the earth's corruption
Noah and his three sons Shem, Ham and Japheth entered the ark together with their wives on the day the flood came
After the flood, Shem, Ham and Japheth became the ancestors of all the nations that spread out over the earth
The Table of Nations – the detailed genealogy of the descendants of Shem, Ham and Japheth, showing how the nations arose after the flood
Shem's genealogy begins here, with the information that Shem was one hundred years old when he fathered Arpachshad two years after the flood
Noah and his sons Shem, Ham and Japheth are mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of humanity's family tree
Connects the birth of the sons before the flood to their role as ancestors of all nations after the flood.
Confirms that the same sons who were born before judgment were the instruments of God's new creation after the flood.
